# Overview

`01_` placed the NanoLuc construct alone in the MDA-MB-231 CDS landscape. This
notebook does the same for the three bicistronic constructs actually being
cloned - eGFP-P2A-NanoLuc, mCherry-P2A-NanoLuc and TagRFP-P2A-NanoLuc - with
NanoLuc alone kept as the reference line to read them against.

**MDA-MB-231 only.** The MCF7-SIX1 counterpart would be `02_`'s background; the
GC3 result points the opposite way there, so the two must not be read off one
panel.

All parts are imported from `accessories/cds seq.xlsx` and assembled here. The
assembly is the part that can go wrong silently, so section 2 states the rules and
section 3 asserts every one of them.

**The whole fusion is one ORF and is measured as one CDS.** P2A is a
ribosome-skipping peptide, not a stop: the ribosome translates straight through
and the two proteins separate co-translationally. So the mRNA carries a single
~1.4 kb coding sequence, and that is what a scanning or elongating ribosome
traverses - which is the quantity these panels are about. The NanoLuc portion
keeps its junction + PEST tail, as in `01_`.

# Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))
```

```{r params}
lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05
cat("lfc_cutoff =", lfc_cutoff, "| padj_cutoff =", padj_cutoff, "\n")
```

# 1. Import the Parts

```{r read_parts}
parts_xlsx <- here("accessories", "cds seq.xlsx")
stopifnot("accessories/cds seq.xlsx not found" = file.exists(parts_xlsx))

parts_tbl <- read_excel(parts_xlsx)
names(parts_tbl)[1] <- "construct"
stopifnot("Expected 'construct' and 'cds' columns" =
            all(c("construct", "cds") %in% names(parts_tbl)))

parts <- parts_tbl %>%
  filter(!is.na(construct), !is.na(cds)) %>%
  transmute(part = tolower(str_trim(construct)),
            seq  = toupper(gsub("\\s", "", cds)))

needed <- c("egfp", "mcherry", "tag_rfp", "p2a", "nanoluc")
stopifnot("A required part is missing from cds seq.xlsx" =
            all(needed %in% parts$part))

pseq <- setNames(parts$seq, parts$part)

# Every part must be clean DNA and in frame before anything is joined.
stopifnot(
  "A part contains non-ACGT characters" =
    all(!grepl("[^ACGT]", pseq[needed])),
  "A part is not divisible by 3" =
    all(nchar(pseq[needed]) %% 3 == 0)
)

part_summary <- tibble(
  part   = needed,
  nt     = nchar(pseq[needed]),
  codons = nchar(pseq[needed]) %/% 3,
  starts_atg = substr(pseq[needed], 1, 3) == "ATG",
  ends_stop  = map_lgl(pseq[needed],
                       ~ codon_split(.x)[nchar(.x) %/% 3] %in% STOP_CODONS),
  internal_stop = map_lgl(pseq[needed], function(s) {
    cd <- codon_split(s); any(cd[-length(cd)] %in% STOP_CODONS)
  })
)
print(part_summary)

stopifnot("A part has an internal stop codon" = !any(part_summary$internal_stop))
```

# 2. Assembly Rules

Three things about the parts as supplied govern how they are joined, and each is
applied explicitly rather than assumed:

1. **mCherry and TagRFP carry terminal stop codons; eGFP does not.** A stop
   upstream of P2A would end translation before NanoLuc, so the terminal stop is
   stripped from any upstream part that has one. This is forced by the biology,
   not a choice.
2. **TagRFP has no initiator ATG.** As supplied it begins `GTG TCT AAG` =
   VSKGEE..., where TagRFP is MVSKGEE... An `ATG` is prepended so the fusion
   starts correctly, matching the other two. This is the one edit made to a
   supplied sequence, and it is asserted below.
3. **NanoLuc is 3'-most and keeps its stop**, along with its junction + PEST tail.
   The stop is stripped only at the end, when CDS metrics are computed, so genes
   and constructs share a stop-free basis.

The P2A supplied is the bare 19-aa ATNFSLLKQAGDVEENPGP, with no GSG linker in
front of it. That is used as given.

```{r assemble}
P2A_AA <- "ATNFSLLKQAGDVEENPGP"
stopifnot("The p2a part does not encode the expected 19-aa P2A peptide" =
            as.character(translate(DNAString(pseq[["p2a"]]))) == P2A_AA)

strip_terminal_stop <- function(s) {
  cd <- codon_split(s)
  if (cd[length(cd)] %in% STOP_CODONS) substr(s, 1, nchar(s) - 3) else s
}

# The upstream fluorophore, made fusion-ready: ATG prepended where absent, any
# terminal stop removed.
prep_upstream <- function(s, name) {
  added_atg <- substr(s, 1, 3) != "ATG"
  if (added_atg) s <- paste0("ATG", s)
  had_stop <- codon_split(s)[nchar(s) %/% 3] %in% STOP_CODONS
  s <- strip_terminal_stop(s)
  cat(sprintf("  %-9s ATG prepended: %-5s terminal stop stripped: %-5s -> %d nt\n",
              name, added_atg, had_stop, nchar(s)))
  stopifnot(
    "Prepared upstream part does not start with ATG" = substr(s, 1, 3) == "ATG",
    "Prepared upstream part still ends in a stop codon" =
      !codon_split(s)[nchar(s) %/% 3] %in% STOP_CODONS
  )
  s
}

cat("Preparing upstream parts:\n")
up <- list(
  egfp    = prep_upstream(pseq[["egfp"]],    "eGFP"),
  mcherry = prep_upstream(pseq[["mcherry"]], "mCherry"),
  tag_rfp = prep_upstream(pseq[["tag_rfp"]], "TagRFP")
)

# Only TagRFP should have needed an ATG; if another part suddenly does, the
# spreadsheet changed and that should be looked at rather than silently fixed.
stopifnot(
  "eGFP unexpectedly needed an ATG prepended"    =
    substr(pseq[["egfp"]], 1, 3) == "ATG",
  "mCherry unexpectedly needed an ATG prepended" =
    substr(pseq[["mcherry"]], 1, 3) == "ATG",
  "TagRFP unexpectedly already had an ATG"       =
    substr(pseq[["tag_rfp"]], 1, 3) != "ATG"
)

# Biological spot-check: each fluorophore's N-terminus, after preparation.
stopifnot(
  "eGFP N-terminus is not MVSKGEELFTG" =
    startsWith(as.character(translate(DNAString(up$egfp))), "MVSKGEELFTG"),
  "mCherry N-terminus is not MVSKGEEDNMAIIK" =
    startsWith(as.character(translate(DNAString(up$mcherry))), "MVSKGEEDNMAIIK"),
  "TagRFP N-terminus is not MVSKGEELIKENMHM" =
    startsWith(as.character(translate(DNAString(up$tag_rfp))), "MVSKGEELIKENMHM")
)
cat("All three fluorophore N-termini match their expected sequences\n")
```

# 3. Build and Verify the Fusions

```{r nanoluc}
nl <- load_nanoluc_construct()
```

```{r build_fusions}
fuse <- function(up_seq) paste0(up_seq, pseq[["p2a"]], nl$full)

fusions <- list(
  "eGFP-P2A-NanoLuc"    = fuse(up$egfp),
  "mCherry-P2A-NanoLuc" = fuse(up$mcherry),
  "TagRFP-P2A-NanoLuc"  = fuse(up$tag_rfp)
)

# nl$full is already stop-free, so each fusion is a stop-free ORF on the same
# basis as the gene CDS sequences. check_orf enforces exactly that.
cat("Fusion ORF validation:\n")
iwalk(fusions, ~ check_orf(.x, .y))

nl_aa_full <- as.character(translate(DNAString(nl$full)))

for (nm in names(fusions)) {
  f  <- fusions[[nm]]
  aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(f)))

  stopifnot(
    # Length is additive: nothing was dropped or duplicated in the join.
    "Fusion length is not the sum of its parts" =
      nchar(f) == nchar(up[[match(nm, names(fusions))]]) +
      nchar(pseq[["p2a"]]) + nchar(nl$full),
    # The P2A peptide must appear exactly once and in frame.
    "P2A peptide not found exactly once in the fusion protein" =
      lengths(gregexpr(P2A_AA, aa, fixed = TRUE)) == 1,
    # The fusion must end with the complete NanoLuc construct protein, PEST
    # included. This is the check that would catch a frame slip at either join:
    # a shifted frame changes every downstream residue.
    "Fusion does not end with the full NanoLuc + PEST protein" =
      endsWith(aa, nl_aa_full),
    # And the NanoLuc DNA must be bit-identical, not merely translate the same.
    "NanoLuc portion of the fusion is not bit-identical to the construct" =
      substr(f, nchar(f) - nchar(nl$full) + 1, nchar(f)) == nl$full
  )
}
cat("All", length(fusions), "fusions: length additive, single in-frame P2A,",
    "C-terminal NanoLuc+PEST bit-identical\n")
```

```{r fusion_table}
fusion_df <- tibble(
  reporter   = names(fusions),
  cds_length = map_int(fusions, nchar),
  gc_pct     = map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc_pct),
  gc3_pct    = map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc3_pct)
)

nl_row <- tibble(
  reporter   = "NanoLuc alone",
  cds_length = nchar(nl$full),
  gc_pct     = orf_gc_pct(nl$full),
  gc3_pct    = orf_gc3_pct(nl$full)
)

ref_df <- bind_rows(nl_row, fusion_df)

stopifnot(
  "Reporter GC% out of range"  = all(ref_df$gc_pct  >= 0 & ref_df$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "Reporter GC3% out of range" = all(ref_df$gc3_pct >= 0 & ref_df$gc3_pct <= 100),
  "A fusion is not longer than NanoLuc alone" =
    all(fusion_df$cds_length > nchar(nl$full))
)

print(ref_df %>% mutate(across(c(gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1))))

# Only the three fusions are drawn. NanoLuc alone stays in ref_df, so it is still
# in the exported percentile table as a reference value, but it is not a
# construct being built and would otherwise read as a fourth candidate.
#
# Colours avoid the density-curve hues (grey70 / #E69F00) and the two reserved
# factor hues (#E69F00 eIF3d, #56B4E9 eIF3e), so no reference line reads as a
# gene group or a knockdown.
ref_plot_df <- fusion_df %>%
  mutate(color    = c("#009E73", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"),
         linetype = "solid")

stopifnot("NanoLuc alone must not be drawn as a reference line" =
            !"NanoLuc alone" %in% ref_plot_df$reporter)
cat("Reference lines drawn:", paste(ref_plot_df$reporter, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

# 4. MDA-MB-231 Background and Gene Set

Identical to `01_`, so the panels are directly comparable to it.

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(
  here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Direction check. These files hold the sictrl_vs_si3d coefficient despite the
# filename stating the ratio the other way round, so positive te_lfc = eIF3d
# promotes. EIF3D's own rna_lfc must be strongly positive because the siRNA
# depletes its target; if it is negative the direction has flipped.
eif3d_rna <- te_hyp %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc is not strongly positive: contrast direction may be flipped" =
            length(eif3d_rna) == 1 && eif3d_rna > 2)
cat("Direction check - EIF3D rna_lfc:", round(eif3d_rna, 2), "\n")

promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, te_padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)
cat("eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes:", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

```{r transcripts}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                   "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))
tx_all      <- fm %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)
tx_promotes <- tx_all %>% filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean)

missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean]

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"), col_types = "cc") %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
            gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

extra_tx_df <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>% dplyr::select(Name, TPM)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>% summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name)) %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids, mean_tpm > 0) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
            by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
cat("Promoted genes with a transcript:", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
```

```{r build_metrics}
metrics_all <- build_cds_metrics(
  here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))

expressed <- tx_all %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>% filter(cds_length > 0)
promoted <- tx_promotes %>%
  inner_join(metrics_all, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>% filter(cds_length > 0)

cat("Expressed transcriptome - valid CDS:", nrow(expressed), "\n")
cat("eIF3d promoted        - valid CDS:", nrow(promoted), "\n")

stopifnot(
  "GC% out of range"  = all(expressed$gc_pct  >= 0 & expressed$gc_pct  <= 100),
  "GC3% out of range" = all(expressed$gc3_pct >= 0 & expressed$gc3_pct <= 100),
  "GC3 median not in expected range [40, 65]" =
    between(median(expressed$gc3_pct), 40, 65)
)

actb <- expressed %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% dplyr::slice(1)
if (nrow(actb) == 1) {
  stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC% outside expected 50-70%" = between(actb$gc_pct, 50, 70))
  cat("ACTB CDS GC%:", round(actb$gc_pct, 2),
      "| GC3%:", round(actb$gc3_pct, 2), "\n")
}
```

# 5. Density Panels

```{r density_setup}
group_cols <- c("All expressed mRNAs"    = "grey70",
                "eIF3d hypoxia promotes" = "#E69F00")
```

```{r panel_length, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_len <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "cds_length",
  xlab    = "CDS length (kb)",
  title   = "CDS length, MDA-MB-231, P2A fusion constructs",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_03_density_cds_length_fusions.pdf",
  luc_tbl = ref_plot_df, group_cols = group_cols,
  xscale  = 1000, xmax = 6
)
```

```{r panel_gc, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC content, MDA-MB-231, P2A fusion constructs",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_03_density_cds_gc_fusions.pdf",
  luc_tbl = ref_plot_df, group_cols = group_cols
)
```

```{r panel_gc3, fig.width=9.5, fig.height=5.5}
p_gc3 <- plot_density_luc(
  expressed, promoted, "gc3_pct",
  xlab    = "CDS GC3 content (%)",
  title   = "CDS GC3 content, MDA-MB-231, P2A fusion constructs",
  outfile = "cds_reporter_03_density_cds_gc3_fusions.pdf",
  luc_tbl = ref_plot_df, group_cols = group_cols
)
```

# 6. Percentiles and Part Contributions

```{r percentiles}
pct_tbl <- reporter_percentiles(expressed, promoted, ref_df)
print(pct_tbl)

stopifnot("Percentiles must lie in [0, 100]" =
            all(pct_tbl$pct_expressed >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_expressed <= 100 &
                pct_tbl$pct_promoted  >= 0 & pct_tbl$pct_promoted  <= 100))

write_csv(pct_tbl,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               "03_fusion_percentiles_vs_231.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/03_fusion_percentiles_vs_231.csv\n")
```

Each part's own composition, to show which component moves a fusion where.

```{r part_contributions}
part_df <- tibble(
  part = c("eGFP", "mCherry", "TagRFP", "P2A", "NanoLuc ORF",
           "junction + PEST", "NanoLuc construct"),
  seq  = c(up$egfp, up$mcherry, up$tag_rfp, pseq[["p2a"]],
           nl$core, nl$pest, nl$full)
) %>%
  transmute(part,
            nt      = nchar(seq),
            codons  = nchar(seq) %/% 3,
            gc_pct  = map_dbl(seq, gc_pct_of),
            gc3_pct = map_dbl(seq, compute_gc3_pct)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(gc_pct, gc3_pct), ~ round(.x, 1)))

print(part_df)

write_csv(part_df,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design", "03_part_composition.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/03_part_composition.csv\n")
```

```{r export_sequences}
# The assembled constructs, so the sequences that were measured are recoverable
# without re-running the assembly.
seq_out <- tibble(
  reporter = names(fusions),
  length_nt_stop_free = map_int(fusions, nchar),
  gc_pct  = round(map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc_pct), 3),
  gc3_pct = round(map_dbl(fusions, orf_gc3_pct), 3),
  bases   = unlist(fusions, use.names = FALSE)
)
write_csv(seq_out,
          here("output", "cds_reporter_design",
               "03_fusion_assembled_sequences.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/cds_reporter_design/03_fusion_assembled_sequences.csv\n")
```

# 7. Summary

```{r summary}
cat("=== P2A fusion constructs vs MDA-MB-231 ===\n\n")

cat("Assembly: <fluorophore, no stop> + P2A (19 aa) + NanoLuc + junction/PEST\n")
cat("TagRFP had ATG prepended; mCherry and TagRFP had terminal stops stripped.\n\n")

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ref_df))) {
  cat(sprintf("%-22s %5d nt (%3d codons)  GC %.1f%%  GC3 %.1f%%\n",
              ref_df$reporter[i], ref_df$cds_length[i],
              ref_df$cds_length[i] / 3, ref_df$gc_pct[i], ref_df$gc3_pct[i]))
}

cat(sprintf("\nMDA-MB-231 medians: all expressed %.0f nt / GC3 %.1f%% | promoted %.0f nt / GC3 %.1f%%\n",
            median(expressed$cds_length), median(expressed$gc3_pct),
            median(promoted$cds_length),  median(promoted$gc3_pct)))

cat("\nPercentile of each construct:\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pct_tbl))) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-22s %-11s %7.1f  ->  %5.1f pct expressed, %5.1f pct promoted\n",
              pct_tbl$reporter[i], pct_tbl$metric[i], pct_tbl$reporter_value[i],
              pct_tbl$pct_expressed[i], pct_tbl$pct_promoted[i]))
}
```
